description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git operations with verbose cURL output. It sets up a repository, configures a test environment, and verifies error handling in Git over HTTP using verbose cURL logs.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts an HTTP daemon server for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, executing the provided commands.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Executes a command that might fail without failing the entire test suite.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
